description: Find and unlock files stuck in 'File in Use' or 'Access Denied' on Windows
notes: This build is compiled from the C# sources shipped in the vendor's archive instead of running its installer: the installer requires administrator rights, writes HKLM context-menu verbs and registers a boot-time watcher (a 'UnBlockWatcher' Run value plus an 'UnBlock-Cleanup' logon scheduled task). None of that happens here.
The archive's own installer ('setup.exe') and its sources are removed after the build, so the only thing left is a plain 'Unlocker.exe' that runs entirely from the Scoop directory.
Because no context-menu verbs are registered, launch 'UnBlock' from the shortcut (or 'Unlocker.exe <path>' from a shell) to inspect a stuck file.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path $csc)) { throw 'csc.exe (.NET Framework 4.x) not found; it is required to compile UnBlock from source.' }
if (!$src) { throw 'UnBlock sources (src\*.cs) were not found in the archive.' }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or !(Test-Path "$dir\Unlocker.exe")) { throw "Failed to compile UnBlock from source (csc exit code $LASTEXITCODE)." }
